div.head: I Atr 1.5
div.ab: Gyf he þonne ful wurðe, æt þæm forman cyrre bete þam teonde twygylde ⁊ þam hlaforde his were ⁊ sette getreowe borgas, þæt he ælces yfeles geswice eft.
Gyf he ðonne ful wurðe, æt ðam forman cyrre bete ðam teonde twygylde ⁊ ðam hlaforde his were ⁊ sette getreowe borgas, þæt he ælces yfel eft geswice.
Et si culpabilis erit, in prima uice reddat compellatori duplo quod repetit et domino suo weram suam et mittat credibiles plegios, quod omnis mali deinceps abstineat.
Gyf he ðonne ful wurðe, æt ðam forman cyrre bete ðam teonde twygylde ⁊ ðam hlaforde his were ⁊ sette getreowe borgas þæt he ælces yfel[es] eft geswice.

If he is found guilty, on the first occasion he shall pay the accuser double value and his wergeld to his lord, and shall appoint trustworthy sureties that henceforth he will desist from every kind of misdeed.

Wenn er nun schuldig befunden wird, büsse er beim ersten Male dem Kläger [den Schaden] doppelt und seinem Herrn sein Wergeld und stelle vertrauenswürdige Bürgen [dafür], dass er jeder Missethat fortan sich enthalten werde.

If he is then found guilty, let him pay the plaintiff double [the damage] the first time and his lord his wergild, and provide trustworthy sureties [to the effect] that he will refrain from all wrongdoing in future.
div.note: After ‘were’ in H, ‘þe his wites wyrðe sy’ (as in 1.7) should perhaps be supplied from II Cn 30.2. Liebermann compares VI As 12.2.
